name: A2

timeline.detail: Unveiled at AgiBot's 'Commercial Voyage' 2024 product launch alongside four sibling models (A2-Max, A2-W, X1, X1-W).
Shown as 'special guest' at a Fortune China event in Macau and awarded Fortune China's Best Design Award 2025; press release does not disclose unit counts.

source.quote: AGIBOT Makes Debut at Fortune Event with Full-Size Humanoid Robot AGIBOT A2 as Special Guest

notes: AgiBot (the brand) is run by Shanghai Zhiyuan New Innovation Technology Co., Ltd. ('Zhiyuan Robotics'); the two names refer to the same company in coverage.

Walking speed (3.3 m/s) and payload (15 kg) are widely repeated by secondary outlets (e.g. RoboZaps, Aparobot) citing the August 2024 launch event, but were not found on a page directly attributable to the manufacturer during this build, so they are omitted here rather than sourced to a non-manufacturer repeat of the claim.

No manufacturer or press source with a named customer and delivery evidence (invoice, serial number, unboxing, customs record) was found during this build; AgiBot separately claims a '5,000th mass-produced humanoid robot' milestone across its whole product line (PR Newswire, 2026), but that figure is not broken out by model, so delivery status here stays 'claimed' rather than 'shipped'.

AgiBot's own product page (agibot.com/products/A2) does not list a price; no primary price source was found during this build, so price_history is left empty rather than using third-party reseller prices (e.g. Top3DShop, RoboZaps).
